findings.quoted_text: No compensation with respect to a Fund shall be due and owing hereunder until the Distributor actually receives payments from such Fund, to the extent applicable.
No compensation with respect to a Fund shall be due and owing hereunder until the Distributor actually receives payments from such Fund, to the extent applicable.
findings.explanation: Your payment is conditional on the Distributor receiving payment from the Fund, which means you might not get paid if the Fund delays or fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: The Distributor shall pay S2K the compensation due hereunder within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I am excited to get started. Before signing, I have one small note: - Regarding the relevant clause, payment is currently conditional on the Distributor receiving funds, which means compensation could be delayed if the Fund does not pay; I propose modifying this so that payment is due within thirty days of the invoice date. Please let me know if this adjustment is acceptable. Best regards,
